role: Personal-infra Atlas-v2 knowledge graph / staleness oracle. Rich-lineage fork; default branch is master.

pitfalls.entry: Default branch is master, NOT main. The generator's behind_origin_main probe reads origin/main only, so behind_origin_main degrades here by design -- read currency against origin/master manually.
Rich-lineage fork: Atlas-v2 work stays in the vault build-plans; intelligence-layer changes live in this fork, never in the wiki paths.
Never merge or direct-push to a default branch -- merge is Anthony's.
